extensionDescription.message: Never waste time wordsmithing your replies. Just say what you mean, and let AI help turn it into a respectful draft before you send.

optionsLede.message: Choose an LLM provider. The extension calls the selected provider directly after you click the Simple Words button.

writingInstructionsLead.message: Teach Simple Words enough about you to make replies feel natural. The full system prompt is there when you need precise control.

myNameHelp.message: Optional. When set, this is included in the rewrite instructions so the model can use it for signatures when appropriate.

systemPromptHelp.message: Leave blank to restore the default system prompt.

enabledDomainsLead.message: Simple Words only appears on these hostnames. Add one domain per line.

enabledDomainsHelp.message: Defaults include Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo Mail, iCloud Mail, and Proton Mail.

providerLead.message: Choose the service Simple Words calls from your browser. Only the selected provider settings are shown.

privacyFootBefore.message: Calls go directly from your browser to your provider.
